description.value: We used voxel-based morphometry to directly correlate regional gray matter volume with behavioral measures of sentence comprehension and working memory in patients with progressive nonfluent aphasia, semantic dementia, and nonaphasic frontotemporal dementia.

spans.text: In the current study we use voxel-based morphometry (Ashburner & Friston, 2000) to determine regions of cortical atrophy that are significantly related to sentence comprehension and working memory in PNFA, SD, and SOC/EXEC patients.

value: We expected, first, that this measure would reflect SOC/EXEC patients’ general executive limitations, and be a way to parsimoniously characterize the role of executive resources in sentence comprehension.

Second, this allowed us to test whether PNFA patients’ left inferior frontal disease forces these patients to compensate for their language limitations by relying on a domain-general form of working memory for the grammatically-demanding sentences.
